title: EBay Stock Jumps on $56 Billion GameStop Offer
title_zh: eBay 股价因 GameStop 560 亿美元报价而上涨
summary: Investors are bidding up eBay shares. That's after GameStop CEO Ryan Cohen told The Wall Street Journal that he had made an unsolicited offer to buy the e-commerce platform, and that he saw a path to make it a much bigger competitor to Amazon.
summary_zh: 投资者正在竞购 eBay 股票。此前，GameStop 首席执行官瑞安·科恩 (Ryan Cohen) 告诉《华尔街日报》，他已主动提出收购该电子商务平台的要约，并且他看到了一条使其成为亚马逊更大竞争对手的途径。

title: Mizuho Financial Group, Inc. (MFG) Units Complete Merger amid Oracle Autonomous AI Integration
title_zh: 瑞穗金融集团 (MFG) 各部门在 Oracle 自主人工智能集成中完成合并
summary: Mizuho Financial Group Inc. (NYSE:MFG) is one of the best Japanese stocks to buy right now. On April 1, Mizuho Financial Group Inc. (NYSE:MFG)’s units, Mizuho Bank and Mizuho Research & Technologies Ltd., completed their planned merger and business integration.

title: BASF Coatings Launches $2 Billion Debt Sale To Fund Carlyle Acquisition
title_zh: 巴斯夫涂料公司启动 20 亿美元债务出售，为凯雷收购提供资金
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus. Banks have moved to launch a debt sale exceeding $2 billion tied to the carve-out of BASF SE's (BASFY) coatings division, a deal that could offer a timely read on investor appetite for chemicals exposure.
summary_zh: 本文首次发表于 GuruFocus。银行已着手启动一项超过 20 亿美元的债务出售，与剥离巴斯夫股份公司 (BASFY) 涂料部门相关，这项交易可以及时了解投资者对化学品敞口的兴趣。

title: Wealth management land grab drives deal boom amid private market upheaval
title_zh: 私人市场动荡之际，财富管理领域的抢地驱动交易热潮
summary: Carlyle CEO Harvey Schwartz. Patrick T. Fallon/Getty Images Wealth management firms are on the auction block, and they’re selling faster than ever.
summary_zh: 凯雷集团首席执行官哈维·施瓦茨。 Patrick T. Fallon/Getty Images 财富管理公司正在拍卖，而且它们的销售速度比以往任何时候都快。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
